input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including person domain, person entity. The platform provides capabilities for global default exception handler, person port, kafka person producer. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to create and manage person domain records, so that I can track and organize person domain data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage person entity records, so that I can track and organize person entity data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to use global default exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use kafka person consumer capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
